title: Why scale features?
statement:
Why convert features to standard units before gradient descent?

[_]{a}

choices: Because NumPy can't handle big numbers
So features on very different scales don't slow or derail gradient descent
To remove the need for a test set
explanations: Scaling the features doesn't change y.

hints: One step size must suit all features.
solution: Standard units put all features on the same scale, so gradient descent converges faster.
